note: Campground beside Big Lake, the largest remaining oxbow lake in Missouri. Sewer/electric/water sites 49-58 sit on the lake side of the west loop road with only lawn and a fringe of trees to the shore; basic sites 59-64 line the park road along the lake to the south. Boat and ATV trailers may park on the grass beside the pad. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +12 / full hookup +20 (2027 = 2026), 50A, water + sewer, weekend 2-night minimum; added military $2, showers/flush/water/dump, no Wi-Fi, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations Apr 15-Oct 31, deep booking link; sites 28 -> 62 (renovated layout), max 73, pull-throughs. Lakefront confirmed on sites 49-58 (and basic 59-64).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront confirmed (per site): the park's 2025 campground map (BigLake_CG_0.pdf, dated 01/25) puts sewer/electric/water sites 49-58 on the WEST side of the west loop road, between the road and Big Lake, and basic sites 59-64 on the lake side of the park road south of the loop. On leaf-off Esri imagery the southern spurs (49-53) run west off the road to within ~10-15 m of the shoreline, with only mown grass and a fringe of trees/riprap between pad and water - no road, driveway or day use. The lake is a ~600-acre oxbow, far over 5 acres. Note the UseDirect points for 49-58 are plotted on the EAST side of the road (a few metres off their pads), so measure from the map/imagery, not the points. Every other row (1-47) is behind the west loop road, at best *view.
